READ BEFORE USING

Know what the numbers mean.

This release is generated by PASADA’s deterministic queue model. The calendar date is assigned for testing. It is not measured Mandaue traffic or a calibrated SUMO result. A field archive is not connected yet.

Count each boundary once

Incoming passages use the 60 m detectors. Outgoing passages use one downstream counter per lane. The 5 m and 30 m detections are not added again. A vehicle can appear at more than one intersection.

Keep gaps visible

Missing intervals are not zero traffic. Incomplete groups have a blank count and explicit coverage. Downloads include source, UTC timestamps, quality and the requested time range.
